title: College of Materials Science and Engineering, Donghua University
content: Aerogel University Research Platform. The College of Materials Science and Engineering at Donghua University is a university materials platform active in fibers, insulation materials, and advanced materials research. Its official work on flexible thermal-insulating aerogel fibers makes it relevant for aerogel insulation development and application-oriented research.
